findings.summary: New owner-check failure exits close before cleanup; early setup failure never calls a bus finalizer. Healthy socket/pending custody remains live; original FD9 is retained, no false acceptance.
findings.required_fix: Once-only finite finalizer covers revalidation and early setup refusal; preserve errors/uncertainty, cancellation/owned-connection close and durable inventory, no clock extension or FD9 release.

findings.summary: Original exact systemd-run argv/environment selects private manager connection and acquires no AddRef. Replacement adds AddRef/UnrefUnit and alters transient reference/GC lifetime.
findings.required_fix: Omit AddRef and UnrefUnit for this exact recipe; update closure proof to no reference acquired and preserve early-event/fast-GC correlation.

prefix.missing: Pre-return native import/connect/auth has no original 4/5-second cancellation; post-return refusal is not phase preemption.
prefix.remedy_candidate: Same-parent finite producer with a supported timeout-aware socket/auth primitive and explicitly bounded Hello/send/event/close. Jeepney 0.9 prep_socket was a research candidate only; its default implicit Hello and async queue defaults do not establish this contract.
